leaked_early.details: Concentra's unsolicited proposal was submitted March 14 and publicly confirmed March 15, 2023, less than 2 weeks before the March 27 announcement; no evidence of a leak 1+ month prior

notes: Deal emerged from an unsolicited bid by a 10%+ shareholder (Tang Capital) that disrupted a pending reverse merger with Redx Pharma; the final $1.85 cash+CVR offer was only a $0.05 increase over the initial $1.80 proposal.
